title: OpenVA Hosted Job Record
description: Operational metadata for one hosted resolver job in the durable job store. Data-minimised and transient by design: it carries NO uploaded inventory content, NO vendor identity strings, and NO request bodies — only a request digest, a row count, lifecycle state, and a TTL. The submitted request lives separately in a transient request envelope (referenced by request_ref) and the result lives in a transient result blob (referenced by result_ref); both are TTL-deleted. Expiry is time-based on expires_at (the API returns 410 once now >= expires_at); there is no persisted 'expired' state. Non-advisory: it never carries a verdict, score, risk level, approval, or suitability. additionalProperties is false so a leaked inventory or identity field fails validation. Operational metadata only; not legal, compliance, procurement, security, KYC, AML, audit, or vendor-risk advice.

job_id.description: Opaque correlation id (UUIDv4). Carries no submitted content and is NOT an access credential; safe to log. Result access requires the separate job_token capability (stored here only as job_token_digest).

job_token_digest.description: SHA-256 of the high-entropy job_token capability returned once at creation. The token gates result polling/retrieval; it is never logged and never stored in plaintext — only this digest persists for verification.

request_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical request for idempotency/dedup only. The request itself is never stored in this record. SHA-256 only (bot constitution).

request_ref.description: Opaque pointer to the TRANSIENT request envelope (submitted input) the worker reads, or null once the envelope is deleted (on completion/failure/abandonment/TTL). Never the input itself.

result_ref.description: Opaque pointer to the transient result blob (also TTL-deleted), or null until completed.

error_code.description: Stable, generic failure code (never an upstream message or submitted content).
